import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_cond_loop_choice_b()
    branch_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function cond_loop_choice_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_branch, i_n, branch_stack)
    if i_branch == 1
        branch_stack[1] = 1
        for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
            loss[1] = loss[1] + u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
        end
    else
        branch_stack[1] = 0
        for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
            loss[1] = loss[1] + v[i_seq_x] ^ 2
        end
    end
    __branch = branch_stack[1]
    if __branch == 1
        for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
            ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
        end
    else
        for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
            vb[i_seq_x] = vb[i_seq_x] + (2 * v[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_cond_loop_choice_b_cuda()
    branch_stack = CuArray{Int64}(undef, 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function cond_loop_choice_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_branch, i_n, branch_stack)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    if i_branch == 1
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                branch_stack[1] = 1
            end
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_1!(i_n, loss, u)
    else
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                branch_stack[1] = 0
            end
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_2!(i_n, loss, v)
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            __branch = branch_stack[1]
        end
    if __branch == 1
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_3!(i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    else
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_4!(i_n, lossb, v, vb)
    end
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_1!(i_n, loss, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_2!(i_n, loss, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += v[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_3!(i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cond_loop_choice_b_4!(i_n, lossb, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    vb[i_seq_x] = vb[i_seq_x] + (2 * v[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_branch = 2
i_n = 4
__base_loss = Float64[0.32661317124726513, 1.5622159826169248, -0.21555496228451154, -1.7216103614032343]
__base_u = Float64[-1.4159101743811295, -0.0717908839008748, 1.1024535761120458, -1.1813765294238583]
__base_v = Float64[-1.190506743269405, 1.1017306878382556, -1.4670102351847956, -1.5768130788943608]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-1.7217174213201667, 0.5371754715709192, -0.6970400253065467, 1.1864684739528182], Float64[0.2882272014754236, 0.37800314023790443, 0.7861896440410227, -0.4811003807340973]]
__seed_u = [Float64[-0.88938447895748, 0.8973727535474881, -2.8443228889039585, -0.057619180435791936], Float64[0.6442251760135805, 0.7465553930297576, -0.9841115523621112, -0.7678166120361446]]
__seed_v = [Float64[0.8887914375039305, 2.3117735393715275, -0.9994655191414947, -0.2404715361153345], Float64[1.1519077124658674, 1.2348655565942106, 2.060389721754526, -0.39721827072707655]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  v_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_v); v_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial])
  v_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_v)); v_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_cond_loop_choice_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_cond_loop_choice_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = cond_loop_choice_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, v_val_cpu, v_sh_cpu, i_branch, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = cond_loop_choice_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, v_val_gpu, v_sh_gpu, i_branch, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_sh_cpu, Array(v_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_val_cpu, Array(v_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
